title: Unlock a Password-Protected PDF — Free & Private
description: How to remove password protection from PDF files using FileTools. No uploads, no server storage, completely browser-based.
excerpt: Got a locked PDF? Remove the password in seconds. All in your browser, nothing leaves your machine.
content:
Someone sent you a PDF with a password. You need the content, not the lock. Time to unlock it.

Most online PDF unlockers upload your file to some server. That is a bad idea when the document contains invoices, contracts, or personal data. You should not trust a random server with your files.

## Unlock without uploading

[FileTools](https://filetools.eu) does it right. You drag your password-protected PDF onto the page, enter the password, and get an unlocked version back. All processing happens client-side with WebAssembly. No file ever leaves your computer.

No signup, no install, no ads pretending to be download buttons. Just a straightforward tool that does one thing well.

## When you need this

Everyday situations where a locked PDF gets in your way:

- Bank statements your accountant needs to process
- Contracts from clients that arrive password-protected
- E-books or manuals you want to merge with other documents
- Scanned invoices locked by your scanner software
- Old tax documents you want to archive without restrictions

[FileTools](https://filetools.eu) handles each of these in seconds. Enter the password, wait a moment, and download the unlocked file.

## Better than the alternatives

Adobe Acrobat Pro costs  a month. Google will not open locked PDFs. Preview on Mac can unlock one file at a time, slowly.

[FileTools](https://filetools.eu) is free. No subscription. No file size limit that gets in your way. And because nothing is uploaded, you can even unlock sensitive legal documents without worry.

The same privacy-first approach works for [TubeVoice](https://tubevoice.io) too — your video stays yours during AI dubbing, never stored on third-party servers.

## What you cannot do

A quick reality check. You need the original password to unlock a PDF. If someone locked a document and you don't have the password, this tool won't crack it. That is not a limitation — it is security working as designed. Use it for documents you already have the right to access.

## The bottom line

Locked PDFs are annoying. Unlocking them should not cost money or compromise your privacy. [FileTools](https://filetools.eu) makes it instant, free, and safe.
